# dokku_http_auth_domain (Data Source)

Manages the set of domains HTTP auth is restricted to for a dokku application

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_http_auth_domain" "example" {
  app = "hello-world"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the app

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Set of String) List of domains to restrict HTTP auth to
- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
